summary: Release candidates with stale @ai-matrx packages previously ran the expensive unit suite before the package freshness gate. The existing freshness gate now runs first for every candidate, including candidates rebuilt after a remote push race. All existing checks remain mandatory and continue to run against the exported candidate SHA.
evidence: The previous release.sh CHECKS list placed unit-tests before matrx-packages.
Release logs on 2026-09-26 at 00:45:07, 02:29:14, and 02:34:08 recorded successful unit suites followed by matrx-packages failures at 102, 103, and 104 seconds respectively.
verification: The release fixture now rejects a stale-package candidate before Vitest and publication, and asserts the package gate reruns on a remote race. The fixture has not been executed in this lane.
limitations: This lane did not run tests, compilation, builds, installation, browser checks, or release; the root owner holds the sole heavy-work permit.
The package freshness gate still needs the registry check on every candidate; this change only avoids spending unit-suite time before a known freshness failure.
next_action: Root owner runs the admitted release fixture and independent verification before release.
